features: ⚠ This update includes two database migrations, applied automatically during the guided update. Your cash account balances do not change: they are simply recorded properly in the ledger.

New Balance Sheet with an automatic accounting check (Assets = Liabilities + Equity). Beyond being a report, it acts as an alarm: if an amount ever enters the books without a matching counter-entry, it is flagged immediately instead of slipping through unnoticed.

A cash account's opening balance is now a real ledger entry, with its counter-entry on the Previous Years' Fund. Before it lived only as a standalone figure, leaving the balance sheet short by that amount — an issue affecting virtually every condominium migrated from another software.

Fixed a case where a cash account balance could differ depending on which screen you looked at: some views excluded reversed entries, others still counted them. The balance now has a single calculation, which always excludes reversed entries.
Fixed an error when creating or editing a Bank-type cash account without filling in the "account holder" field: if left blank, the condominium name is now used as intended.

Fixed the available-liquidity calculation when filtered by a single management: the bank account's opening balance was left out, so liquidity could read as zero despite real money being in the bank, triggering false cash alerts.
